data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-B-N’ which means 'father'. The name Abnus is a title given to the father of a prophet or a revered spiritual figure. In Islamic history, there are several figures with this name, including the father of Prophet Musa (Moses) and Prophet Yunus (Jonah).
